Hot Roll Mix
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:01am

Ingredients




5 pounds Unbleached All Purpose Flour
4 teaspoons Salt
1 1/4 cups Sugar
1 cup Instant Non Fat Dry Milk

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Stir together to distribute evenly. Put in a large airtight container. Lable as HOT ROLL MIX and store in a cool dry place. Use within 6 to 8 months. 2 Makes about 22 cupsof HOT ROLL MIX.
